outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: GBA-style pixel art side-view 2D fighting game stage background.
Create an empty Pokémon-inspired woodland battle arena, no characters, no text and no UI. Wide landscape composition in EXACT 3:2 aspect ratio, preferably 1536x1024; intended native game resolution is 240x160 pixels. Pixel-perfect handheld game aesthetic with crisp square pixels, limited warm cohesive color palette and no antialiasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
Layout for an actually playable side-view fighter: distant pale blue sky and soft blocky clouds in the upper quarter, layers of blue-green hills behind dense trees, a quiet woodland with large trunks and leafy canopies framing the LEFT and RIGHT outer edges. A little stream and a small wooden footbridge only in the distant midground. The middle of the screen is open and uncluttered. Across the FULL WIDTH a perfectly LEVEL continuous horizontal grass platform top is at exactly 80 percent of image height. The lower 20 percent is a clean cross-section of rich ochre dirt with a few small stones and roots. The platform must have NO stairs, gaps, obstacles, slopes, or foreground objects. The horizon and scenery are side-view, not isometric or top-down. Readable silhouettes for colorful fighters placed in front. Bright relaxed daytime, gentle green and turquoise scenery with golden light. Background only; completely opaque. No Pokémon, people, logos, letters, health bars, decorative borders or ground battle circles.

GBA-era handheld-game look, crisp blocky pixels, dark outlines, limited color palette. All eight full-body sprites of this same character face RIGHT. Arrange EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS on a wide 2:1 canvas. Equal cells, ample transparent space between the sprites, same scale in every pose, feet on the same baseline. Top row left to right: neutral ready pose, second neutral ready pose, running step one, running step two. Bottom row left to right: playful move windup, cheerful special move gesture with a small electric sparkle to the right, surprised flinch, sleeping curled up on the ground. Family-friendly solo videogame animation study, no opponents and no injuries. Each sprite entirely contained in its own cell, all eight visible including all tails and ears. No text, labels, grid lines, floor, shadows, watermark, or checkerboard. Genuinely transparent background.
